en: A commemorative postcard featuring an old rural scene with a dirt road, cyclists, pedestrians, horse‑drawn vehicle, wooden fences, and farm buildings in a village landscape. At the left upper side there is an oval portrait of a uniformed man. At the top center is a circular postal cancellation mark with a ship and text in Estonian. Along the bottom is a white caption in Estonian mentioning Peet Julge and Heltermaa on 23 November 1918.
